headline: Haleon Shares Drop to Three-Week Low Following Growth Downgrade
summary: Haleon shares fell to a three-week low after the company issued a growth downgrade alongside a £500 million share buyback program.
why: Consumer healthcare earnings revisions and capital allocation announcements directly influence investor sentiment and equity valuations for defensive consumer brands.

impacts.name: Haleon plc
impacts.why: A lower growth outlook reduces expected future cash flows, putting downward pressure on the stock.
